title: (re)connect Family Nature Gathering
short_description: A slow, magical space for families to ground, share & play. Kids program, yoga, adventures, cacao ceremony, sharing & singing circles, sauna, vegan meals and lots of fun.
description:
In a world that moves so quickly, there is a quiet magic in coming together and reconnecting.

Dear Parents and Kids,

🦋 We warmly invite you to become a part of our Family Nature Gathering in Essência where we live together with our children between hills, gardens and a mystical forest close to the most magnificent beaches of the Algarve, Portugal. 

🌻 From the 16.9.26 - 20.9.26 we come together to (re)connect to ourselves, other parents and kids, the earth and the power of the tribe.

🦋 (re)connect is a space to experience the support of each other when we accompany our children on their path. It is a space where we breathe, share, care and play together.

🌻 Every day we create a loving and inspiring program to feel our hearts, roots and creativity. It will be a slow and spacious flow of the day to ground and interact with the magical nature around us.

🛖 Stay in one of our Glamping tents, your own Camper Van or tent or in one of our rooms in the Farmhouse.

🎬️ Watch our promotion **video** on Instagram: \
<https://www.instagram.com/reel/DbIf9zeIAk5>

### What we will offer

🌳 Morning practice for parents & kids (yoga, dance, meditation…)\
🐞 Loving KidsSpace\
🌳 Creative Workshops\
🐞 Cacao~Ceremony\
🌳 Ecstatic Dance\
🐞 Nature & Beach Adventures\
🌳 Mother & Father Circles\
🐞 vegan community meals\
🌳 Sauna Afternoon\
🐞 Heart Sharings

#### 🦥 Where

Essência Nature Retreat, Aljezur, Portugal

#### 💗 When

16th of September - 20th of September 2026

#### 💎 Arrival

Airport „Faro“, Portugal -> Uber to Essência Nature Retreat.

#### 🌱 Language

English, German 

### 🌀 Registration and Questions

<https://forms.gle/B61jzVhhF8j3MADa6>

#### Please note

*Farmhouse rooms and glamping tents are equipped with one double bed (or two single beds).
1–2 additional mattresses (depending on room size; subject to availability) can be provided for children. Please inquire when booking.
If your family requires additional rooms or tents, these can be booked for an additional fee.\
Upon request and for an additional fee, you can also arrive earlier and depart later, allowing you to enjoy your stay at Essência a little longer.*
